implementation_note: Rank vectors/timing use the corrected tuple-key memoizer from coalition_rank_cache_shadowing_correction_v0. The representation-switch protocol was frozen before the first outcome; the memoization defect was discovered afterward, so only corrected-cache performance metrics are reported here. Exact node counts/rank vectors were unchanged by the defect.
closed_form: For m independent equivalence pairs the exact rank polynomial is (1+z^2)^m. The direct deterministic/decomposable circuit has 7 nodes per pair plus m-1 decomposable AND nodes = 8m-1. Under the tested interleaved order the reduced OBDD has 3m live nonterminals; under the tested blocked x...x,y...y order the measured sequence is 3*(2^m-1) live nonterminals for m=4,6,8,10,12.
observations: The constructed family exhibits a clean representation/order interaction: direct smooth deterministic decomposable circuits stay linear while a blocked OBDD grows exponentially over the tested sequence.
A favorable interleaved OBDD is even smaller than the direct circuit (3m vs 8m-1), so the result supports conditional representation switching, not abandoning OBDDs.
Exact rank-polynomial evaluation is natural on the direct decomposable circuit and matched the same closed-form rank vector as both OBDD orders.
This family is deliberately constructed and does not establish that real certifier workloads will exhibit the same separation.
scope: Constructed independent-equivalence formulas only; no TiDiDi/TDD implementation or proof-utility claim.
